technical-summary: Fixed error-handling defects found in audit. runner.py: bound exception (except Exception as exc) so the spawn-failure error string no longer raises NameError. state_machine.py: cascade failures upgraded from logger.debug to logger.warning with exc_info=True. lsp_lifecycle.py: diagnostics() now logs a warning before returning {}; added missing 'import logging' + module logger (file previously had no logger, so the audit's suggested fix would itself NameError). propagation_config.py: log a warning when states_for_kind raises, instead of silently falling back to an empty set.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed several error-handling bugs: a NameError in the updater spawn path, silent diagnostics/validation failures now logged, and cascade failures raised to warning level.

technical-summary: Added regression tests for the four error-handling fixes in chg_20260618_000000_errhandling_fixes. test_update_runner.py (new): patches subprocess.Popen to raise and asserts _schedule_post_exit_install returns an error dict (no NameError) and cleans up the temp PS1 (win32-only via skipif). test_state_machine.py: asserts cascade failure logs at WARNING with exc_info, not DEBUG. test_lsp_lifecycle.py: asserts diagnostics() logs a warning before returning {} (also guards the module logger). test_propagation_config.py: asserts validate() logs a warning when states_for_kind raises. All 4 pass.
user-summary-candidate: Added regression tests covering the error-handling bug fixes so they don't reappear.

technical-summary: Fixed provider CLI probes failing with WinError 2 on Windows. Root cause: probes ran a bare argv list (subprocess.run(["opencode","--version"])) which CreateProcess cannot use to launch npm/pip .CMD shims. Added shared adapters/probe.py with run_cli() (shell-routes on Windows, direct exec on POSIX) and probe_cli_version() (which-resolve + run + correct available flag). Refactored opencode and openhands probes to use probe_cli_version (also fixed their except handler that returned available=True on failure). Routed copilot, qwen, and roo subprocess calls through run_cli (preserving their present-on-PATH availability semantics). Added regression tests covering missing executable, spawn failure -> available False, success/nonzero exit, cross-platform run_cli, a win32-only .CMD shim test proving bare list fails while run_cli succeeds, and opencode delegation to the shared helper. All 7 new tests + existing provider unit suite pass; ruff clean.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed provider CLIs (opencode and others) reporting WinError 2 on Windows by running their version probes through the shell so npm-installed .CMD shims resolve correctly.

technical-summary: Validated all providers in Docker and added a cross-provider probe contract test. Ran tests/dev/run_provider_cli_isolated.py (bind-mounted) across all 12 installable providers in isolated Linux containers: every provider passed real install/health/uninstall (plandex brew roundtrip skipped per harness.yaml policy; no failures). Confirmed the default probe _probe_cli (registry.py) resolves the full executable via shutil.which before running, so it is unaffected by the Windows .CMD bug; the continue and pi custom probes do not spawn subprocess (which-check / file-check). Added tests/unit/providers/test_provider_probe_contract.py: parametrized over every PATH-based provider probe, stubs shutil.which to None and asserts _probe_provider_cli returns available=False with executable=None — guarding the whole class of bug (probe crash or masking failure as available) across all providers on any platform. 14 tests pass; full provider unit suite green; ruff clean.
user-summary-candidate: Verified every provider installs and runs correctly in Docker, and added a test ensuring no provider's availability check crashes or falsely reports installed when its CLI is missing.

technical-summary: Slimmed and made provider agent surfaces consistent. contributions.py: added managed agent-jobs/overview preamble, dropped redundant agent-jobs/tag-shortcuts (aliases live in tag registry), trimmed agent-jobs/canonical-rule so it no longer duplicates prompt-tags routing doctrine. ag-review.yaml: merged ag-review/review-doctrine into ag-review/doctrine. agent-ledger.yaml: merged agent-ledger/write-instruction into agent-ledger/process and corrected field spec to the 5 schema-required fields. Normalized all 7 agent files to managed-only content with overview first, removing inconsistent legacy unmanaged prompt-tag drift. Net 13->11 contributions; apply idempotent (plan changed=False), prune removed 3 stale blocks. Added test_surface_consistency.py guarding slim synthetic contributions, removed-ids-stay-gone, and no-unmanaged-content in tracked agent files.
user-summary-candidate: Slimmed the generated agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md etc.) and made them consistent across all providers, removing duplicated doctrine to cut context overhead.

technical-summary: Added update_global_embedded_rig: updates the shared global harness embedded-rig llama-server binaries (harness_runtime/rig/bin) rather than the project-local copy. session_embedded_rig.update_global_embedded_rig + _update_global_embedded_rig_impl run binaries.update_binaries against the global bin dir, detect whether a project-local rig still takes precedence (via launch.runtime_bin_dir) and warn accordingly, returning ok/output/global_active/project_local_overrides_global. Exposed through session_api and as the ag-session-mgmt MCP tool update_global_embedded_rig, registered in session.yaml direct-tools with descriptions. Added unit test for the impl and updated the e2e component-server tool-list assertion.
user-summary-candidate: Added an update_global_embedded_rig tool to update the shared global embedded rig binaries, warning when a project-local rig overrides them.

technical-summary: Added a 'console' logging format. foundation/logging/config.py: new _ConsoleFormatter renders user-facing console lines ([Label] message, with optional ANSI colour and exception tail) instead of raw log records; the audiagentic.launcher logger maps to the AUDiaGentic label, others to the trailing logger segment. configure_logging selects it when cfg.format == 'console'. logging.yaml documents the new option (json | dev | console). Added unit test coverage.
user-summary-candidate: Added a console logging format that prints clean user-facing lines instead of raw log records.

technical-summary: Import-order normalization only (isort/ruff): reordered imports in coding_lsp language_registry.py and language_servers_sync.py, and moved the tests.integration.providers.harness import into the third-party/local grouping in test_provider_lsp_e2e.py. No behavioral change.
user-summary-candidate: Tidied import ordering in coding-lsp modules and an LSP e2e test.
